nodes.label: Mac Widget Extension (HouseWidgetsMac)
nodes.rationale: A macOS 14 app extension named HouseWidgetsMac, embedded into HouseControl.app by scripts/build-app.sh because the Mac app itself is a Swift package.

nodes.label: Sandboxed Widget Extension
nodes.rationale: WidgetKit requires the extension to be sandboxed with hardened runtime; the host app is not, so the extension is the only sandboxed component.

nodes.label: Widgets Depend on HouseCore
nodes.rationale: The extension links the same shared package as the apps, so snapshot and action rules are one implementation rather than a second copy in the widget.
